description: Reconcile two datasets you supply and get one answer plus every disagreement. Reports keys present on only one side, keys duplicated on either side, whether the join is really 1:1 or silently N:M, and field-level differences with the row number on each side. Numbers compare exactly on their decimal text, never through floating point, so 42.50 and 42.5 agree while 9007199254740992 and 9007199254740993 do not. A repeated key is compared as an unordered multiset. Nothing is fetched. Pay 200000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

compare.description: Columns to compare for matched rows. Defaults to every non-key column the two sides share.

oneOf.description: A column named the same on both sides.
A column named differently on each side, such as order_id against orderId.

delimiter.description: Single field separator for both sides. Defaults to a comma.

key.description: The columns the two sides are joined on. A composite key is supported.

oneOf.description: A column named the same on both sides.
A column named differently on each side, such as order_id against orderId.

csv.description: Delimited text including a header row, at most 262144 bytes. RFC 4180 quoting is honoured.

name.description: Label echoed back in the report, so a caller reading it later knows which side was which.

numeric_tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance when both values read as numbers, as a number or as a decimal string for a tolerance finer than a double can hold. Defaults to 0, which still treats 42.50 and 42.5 as equal because they are the same number. A non-zero tolerance is not an equivalence relation, so a repeated key cannot be compared order-independently under one and is reported unexamined.

csv.description: Delimited text including a header row, at most 262144 bytes. RFC 4180 quoting is honoured.

name.description: Label echoed back in the report, so a caller reading it later knows which side was which.

name: dataset_reconciliation

ambiguous_key_count.description: Repeated keys that could not be compared order-independently, because a non-zero tolerance was in force or a value fell outside the exact envelope. These are unexamined, never reconciled.

cardinality.description: The join as it actually is, not as it was assumed. A caller expecting 1:1 and getting N:M is the finding that matters most here.

compared_columns.description: The resolved comparison columns, which is what the default inferred if compare was omitted.

comparison.description: How equality was decided: exact decimal comparison, the tolerance actually applied, multiset handling for repeated keys, and the declared exact envelope.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means some of the data was not compared, which is a different problem from data that disagrees.

difference_count.description: The true total number of field differences.

column.description: The column name, or the literal (group) when a repeated key was compared as a multiset.

group_comparison.description: Set to multiset when a repeated key was compared as unordered groups.

left_row.description: 1-based and counting the header row, so it matches a text editor.

numeric_delta.description: The same difference as a number, offered only when one identifies that exact decimal, so sorting by it never disagrees with the text beside it.

numeric_delta_text.description: left minus right as exact decimal text, always present when both sides read as numbers.

only_in_left_rows.description: For a multiset difference, the value tuples surplus on the left, with row numbers.

differences_by_column.description: Counts per column, for triage without reading the list.

key_columns.description: The resolved join columns for each side.

left.description: Row counts supplied and read, joinable keys, duplicated keys and rows with an empty key.

matched_row_pair_count.description: Row pairs actually compared, which differs from matched_key_count when a key repeats.

multiset_matched_key_count.description: Repeated keys whose groups agreed as unordered multisets. No row-to-row pairing is implied for these.

not_comparable_count.description: Values that could not be compared because they fall outside the declared exact envelope. Never counted as agreement.

not_examined.description: Named reasons anything was left uncompared: rows beyond the bound, empty key columns, uneven duplicate counts for a key, values beyond numeric range, or truncated listings.

only_in_left.description: Keys present only on the left, with their row numbers. Bounded; the count above is the true total.

only_in_left_count.description: The true total, even when the listing below is bounded.

reconciled.description: The single field to branch on. True only when the comparison was complete, no key was on one side alone, and no matched row disagreed.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

right.description: The same counts for the right side.
